items.title: Submit payslips for February to April 2027
items.quote: Reichen Sie uns bitte bis 14.05.2027 Ihre Lohnabrechnungen für Februar bis April 2027 ein.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date: 14.05.2027. This falls on a Friday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed. Failing to submit risks a finding of no entitlement for the affected months (§ 41a Abs. 3 SGB II).

items.title: File Widerspruch against the provisional benefit decision
items.quote: Dieser Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, mit dem Widerspruch angefochten werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 23.04.2027 (posting day). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter from a social-law authority sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Tue 27.04.2027. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) begins Wed 28.04.2027 and would end Thu 27.05.2027 (§ 188 Abs. 1/2 BGB). 27.05.2027 is Fronleichnam, a public holiday in Bayern, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next business day: Fri 28.05.2027.
